panels.title: PostgreSQL vs Redis probe p95 · sampled
panels.description: These are sampled dependency probe durations. PostgreSQL includes Docker/psql startup and is not pure server query latency; use PostgreSQL and Redis resource panels to corroborate bottleneck hypotheses.

panels.title: Pronunciation and definition providers
panels.description: Both environments emit fixed-ID Dictionary Builder provider checks from the same read-only preview contract. Live uses a fixed sample word and exports only checked/available status; the preview does not write Library or student records.

panels.description: Live LanguageTool and CMUdict feeds are read-only vendor checks. News Check and submit are not run on live; customer workflow writes remain held.

options.content: The 20-row table combines scheduled environment checks with read-only service/vendor probes; it does not claim live customer workflow writes. Unconfigured vendors display NOT CONFIGURED. News, student-save, and Dictionary Builder live workflows are not synthesized. Student-save latency is the measured mean of real writes only. PostgreSQL probes include client/Docker startup. Redis uses authenticated role probes plus container and cAdvisor resource metrics; its dedicated exporter stays off until persistent read-only ACL support is configured. Loki receives allowlisted monitoring-container logs only.

panels.title: Redis aggregate diagnostics
panels.description: Authenticated Redis role probes, latency, and shared-container resource metrics. A direct exporter requires a persistent read-only ACL account; no application credentials are reused.

panels.title: Container CPU and memory · SIS / PostgreSQL / Redis
panels.description: cAdvisor is docker-only and exports resource totals for the named SIS and Redis containers. Values are shared-host measurements.

panels.title: Monitoring service logs · Loki
panels.description: Loki receives logs only from the explicit monitoring-container allowlist. SIS application, PostgreSQL, and student/parent request logs are excluded.

panels.title: Loki WAL filesystem use
panels.description: Shared Loki monitoring service. WAL writes pause at 95% filesystem use. This is the measured filesystem-wide pressure on Loki's WAL volume.

panels.title: Loki ingestion and WAL guard
panels.description: Current accepted log throughput and disk guard events over fifteen minutes. Loki write guard events are reported by Loki's WAL metrics.
